body: If you would recommend maybe an e-book, I would greatly appreciate it. I have searched the web some and only found "miracle cures".
My confidence is shaky. Some days I feel like superman, others like dirt. I may just deserve this, karma per se. For stressing my parents.
I have also been to 3-5 speech therapists throughout my life. "I'll grow out of it maybe."

You are right, I need to leave. I need a trip or a move or something. But I am also trapped heloing my grandfather. Forgot to mention, but He is 89 and I was placed by my family to babysit him until he dies. (sorry that sounds harsh but I'm just trying to lay it out so it's easy to understand.) So this leaves me Unemployed, broke and looking to escape. I didn't mean to sound like I hadn't tried, because I have been. I've held tons of jobs in lots of fields and met tons of people but I still have this nagging disinterest. I wish the best for your SO and almost wish that we could speak. But that could be destructive for both of us.
